`enum TextureFilter`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.texture` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [TextureFilter.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/texture/TextureFilter.java)

How a texture is sampled between its texels.

- [Textures and samplers](/build/pipeline/#textures-and-samplers)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`NEAREST`](#TextureFilter-value-NEAREST) | The nearest texel, for pixel art and textures drawn at their size; it reads the first mipmap level only. |
| [`LINEAR`](#TextureFilter-value-LINEAR) | A blend of the four nearest texels, and of two mipmap levels for a mipmapped texture. |
